newsitem.title: USA: IPO FILING-Schick files for 1.75 mln shrs.
newsitem.headline: IPO FILING-Schick files for 1.75 mln shrs.

text.p: Schick Technologies Inc filed late Tuesday with the Securities and Exchange Commission an initial public offering of up to 1.75 million common shares it expects to sell between $15 and $17 each.

The Long Island City, N.Y. maker of digital radiography devices used in dental X-ray computer imaging systems said it will use the proceeds from the sale to repay outstanding bank debt, expand its research and development activities, for marketing costs and other general corporate needs.
Underwriters for the offering are Lehman Brothers, J.P. Morgan & Co and Pacific Growth Equities Inc. They have an over-allotment option, but the company has not yet disclosed that amount.
After the offering, the company will have 9,707,231 shares outstanding.
For the year ended March 31, the company reported a net loss of $352,000 on net revenue of $16.1 million. That compares to a net loss of $113,000, on net revenue of $6.8 million the year earlier.
